description: Sri Lanka Customs Rates of Exchange W.E.F. 15.09.2025 to 21.09.2025
reasoning: This gazette notification establishes new rates of exchange for customs duties and other charges under the Customs Ordinance. It constitutes a regulatory framework and compliance requirement issued by statutory authority (Director General of Customs), making it a Legal/Regulatory gazette. The content involves regulatory powers, statutory instruments, and legal compliance requirements for customs operations.
